answer.worked:
Plot each point starting from the origin $(0,0)$:
- $A(1, 12)$: move $1$ unit right, $12$ units up
- $B(3, 4)$: move $3$ units right, $4$ units up
- $Y(18, 10)$: move $18$ units right, $10$ units up
- $X(6, 12)$: move $6$ units right, $12$ units up
- $L(6, 11)$: move $6$ units right, $11$ units up
- $N(6, 1)$: move $6$ units right, $1$ unit up
- $E(0, 4)$: move $4$ units up on the $y$-axis
- $F(6, 0)$: move $6$ units right on the $x$-axis
